events.name: Paint
events.description: The panel needs to be drawn.
events.useCase: Draw custom graphics such as a border or a chart.

events.name: Resize
events.useCase: Reposition or resize the controls inside it by hand.

events.name: ControlAdded
events.description: A control is added to the panel.
events.useCase: Track controls that are created at run time.

events.name: Enter
events.description: Focus moves into the group box or one of its controls.
events.useCase: Highlight the group the user is working in.

events.name: Paint
events.description: The group box needs to be drawn.
events.useCase: Add custom graphics to the frame.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.useCase: Load the content of the newly shown page.

events.name: Selecting
events.description: A tab is about to be selected. Setting Cancel prevents the switch.
events.useCase: Keep a tab locked until the user has the right to see it.

events.name: Selected
events.useCase: Run code after a page is shown.

events.name: Deselecting
events.description: The current tab is about to be left. Setting Cancel keeps it.
events.useCase: Validate or confirm before leaving a page.

events.name: Enter
events.description: The page becomes active, which happens when its tab is selected.
events.useCase: Refresh the page content when it is shown.

events.name: Leave
events.useCase: Save the changes of a page when the user leaves it.

events.name: SplitterMoved
events.description: The user has finished moving the splitter.
events.useCase: Remember the width of a sidebar.

events.name: SplitterMoving
events.description: The user is dragging the splitter. Setting Cancel stops the move.
events.useCase: Stop a panel from becoming too small.

events.name: ControlAdded
events.description: A control is added to the panel.
events.useCase: Update a counter or style new controls.

events.name: ControlRemoved
events.description: A control is removed from the panel.
events.useCase: Update a counter or release resources.

events.name: CellPaint
events.description: A cell of the grid needs to be drawn.
events.useCase: Colour the header row or draw a custom cell background.
